datasets.describes: First run: one admin, no models, no bundles. Tests the empty states and the first upload.

Two published models (a 3 page student model and a 7 page architect model) built from the converted template, three buyers (one with 20000 points, one with 0, one with an exact balance), four top-up bundles.
A realistic first month: 5 models, 20 buyers, 30 purchases, a few drafts, 2 queued conversions.
The biggest expected load: 200 models of 7 pages, 2000 buyers, 50000 ledger rows, 5000 drafts. For speed, gallery, admin list and balance checks.

Awkward cases: Arabic names and right-to-left layout, very long titles, a buyer at exactly the price, an expired draft, a failed conversion, 20 queued conversions (expected finish 5 hours 15 minutes), photos far too small to print, an unpublished model with an unpublished page.
A set of sample photos at known sizes (small, medium, A1-sharp, huge) used by the other packs and for the print-quality warning and export tests.

flags.description: The editor loads the small preview images instead of the full-size files.
A paid export is rendered on the server and returned as one zip. Off means the browser export of one page.
Drafts autosave to the browser and sync to the server.
Each photo shows how sharp it will print. Built and on everywhere.
Arabic interface with the layout mirrored right to left.
An uploader sees the expected finish time of the conversion queue.
Designer applications and accounts. Postponed past the first launch, so off everywhere.
